testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.data.datasource.rest.PinnedHttpsTransportTests

testcase.name: GET over verified TLS sends the credential header and returns the body()
nothing listening is a connect failure with a fixed message()
the certificate must match the host name()
a truncated body is an invalid response, not a short success()
response size is capped for content-length, chunked and until-close bodies()
a response dripped slowly cannot outlive the total deadline()
a server that never answers hits the deadline()
the connection goes to the address that was checked - no second lookup()
only https URLs without credentials are accepted()
a name that resolves to a public and an internal address is refused as a whole (DNS rebinding set)()
loopback private link-local and metadata targets are refused before any socket is opened()
a redirect is returned and never followed, and the credential goes nowhere else()
header injection and forbidden headers are refused before anything is sent()
failures never reach the log with a host, an address or a credential()
ambiguous or malformed responses are rejected()
chunked and until-close bodies are read()
